# Requirements Quality Checklist: End-to-End In-Game Verification (Gate 3)

**Purpose**: Validate that the specification's functional requirements, success criteria, and acceptance conditions are complete, clear, consistent, and measurable — as a "unit test" for the requirements themselves.
**Created**: 2026-10-25
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements. Items test whether requirements are well-written, not whether implementation works.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are all three user scenarios (US1 maintainer, US2 contributor, US3 CI) defined with explicit acceptance conditions? [Completeness, Spec §User Scenarios]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are all functional requirements (FR-001 through FR-003) decomposed into sub-requirements with measurable outcomes? [Completeness, Spec §Functional Requirements]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are all non-goals explicitly listed with clear boundaries (what is excluded and why)? [Completeness, Spec §Non-Goals]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are all dependencies listed with their current status (exists / pending / blocked)? [Completeness, Spec §Dependencies]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are all assumptions documented with their validation status? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK006 - Is the evidence bundle format fully specified (manifest.json schema, claims.json structure, artifact directory layout)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001c]
- [ ] CHK007 - Are all edge cases identified (NaN tiles, Moderate band, save preservation, D1 multi-client)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002b, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is the acceptance criteria section complete with all pass/fail conditions? [Completeness, Spec §Acceptance Criteria]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK009 - Is "verified" quantified with specific, measurable criteria (1 session + 3 signals + thresholds)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002b, §Success Criteria]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is "maintainer-verified with multi-signal evidence" distinguished from "independently verified" with clear transition criteria? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications Round 4/5]
- [ ] CHK011 - Are the health tier thresholds (34/67) explicitly defined with their source (HealthCategory.cs)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002b]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is the multiplicative math (Pobre 1.15×, Moderado 1.00×, Saudável 0.85×) specified with base cache and idempotency? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002a]
- [ ] CHK013 - Is "DayEnding" vs "DayStarted" explicitly justified with SMAPI evidence? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications Round 4]
- [ ] CHK014 - Are all vague adjectives ("robust", "credible", "sufficient") quantified or contextualized? [Clarity, Spec §Success Criteria]
- [ ] CHK015 - Is the save comparator's comparison algorithm specified (which fields, what tolerance, output format)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001b] [Gap]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK016 - Are the 3-signal triangulation requirements consistent across FR-001b, FR-001c, FR-002b, and FR-003a? [Consistency, Spec §Functional Requirements]
- [ ] CHK017 - Do the growth modifier thresholds (34/67) align with HealthCategory.cs definitions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002b, §Success Criteria]
- [ ] CHK018 - Are the "verified" definition and "independently verified" goal consistent across all clarification rounds? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK019 - Do FR-001a (manual protocol primary) and FR-003a (scripted local primary) resolve their apparent tension? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001a, §FR-003a] [Conflict]
- [ ] CHK020 - Are the 4-state failure model (pass/fail/errored/partial/skipped) requirements consistent with the 3-signal evidence requirement? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001c]
- [ ] CHK021 - Do the Non-Goals correctly exclude only what is out of scope (not accidentally excluding in-scope items)? [Consistency, Spec §Non-Goals]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK022 - Are acceptance criteria testable (each AC has a clear pass/fail condition)? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §Acceptance Criteria]
- [ ] CHK023 - Is the "In-game runs ≥ 1" criterion measurable with specific evidence requirements? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria Quantitative]
- [ ] CHK024 - Is the "≤30 min" reproducibility criterion for the protocol specified with measurement method? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria Qualitative]
- [ ] CHK025 - Are all acceptance criteria free of implementation details (no Harmony, Postfix, etc.)? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §Success Criteria Technology-agnostic]

- [ ] CHK026 - Are primary flow requirements (maintainer verifies Phase 2) complete? [Coverage, Spec §US1]
- [ ] CHK027 - Are secondary flow requirements (contributor reproduces) complete? [Coverage, Spec §US2]
- [ ] CHK028 - Are tertiary flow requirements (CI/build verification) complete with deferred scope? [Coverage, Spec §US3]

- [ ] CHK034 - Are D1 multi-client requirements scoped as separate obligation? [Edge Case, Spec §Dependencies, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK035 - Are harvest quality requirements explicitly deferred with rationale? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-002b, §Non-Goals]

## Notes

- Items marked `[Gap]` indicate requirements that may be missing from the spec
- Items marked `[Conflict]` indicate potential contradictions requiring resolution
- Items marked `[Resolved Round 6]` indicate ambiguities resolved in the latest clarification round
- Review ownership: reviewer marks `[x]` only after confirming the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate but does not modify markers
